scope: Independent review of all18 completed root reading notes and current catalog/recipe data, plus selected source blocks. This is NOT a second full105555-word novel reading.
auxiliary_checks: Case-insensitive eagle keyword search in complete normalized extraction returned no occurrences; this supported the alias check and did not replace note inspection.
Every recipe label/source ingredient list/game ingredient list/method inspected for generic-template mismatch.
Named character index compared against all18 reading-note people/faction sections.
Final adjacent refinement rechecked: crusted dace method separates descriptive source assembly from cultivated-parsley game instructions; original16 findings remain resolved.

findings.observed_problem: Alias list includes sea eagle although the character is a grey heron. This is an identity/species error, not an unresolved source variant.
findings.required_correction: Remove sea eagle from Rulango aliases. Preserve grey heron and nonverbal communication. Source1781/1788 inspected; an auxiliary search found no eagle occurrence anywhere in the available normalized source.
findings.resolution_observed: Rechecked Rulango: only grey heron alias remains.

findings.observed_problem: Several verified aliases appear in fact prose but their machine alias arrays are empty. Search/identity reconciliation loses these mappings.
findings.required_correction: Add Ruff to Ruffgar; Brog and applicable Skipper title to Brogalaw; Gurth, Gurt Gurth and raw engraved Gwrt to Gurth; Grenn to this book-qualified chief; Tor to Torleep; Grin to Grinak; Dribbler to Windcoat; Skikkles/Skikkle Bee Spikediggle and Burrtrump only as explicitly qualified speech/name fragments for Skittles. Do not fabricate a single normalized full legal name from toddler speech.
findings.resolution_observed: Rechecked all eight identity records: aliases now indexed; toddler fragments remain separate strings and qualified in source fact.

findings.observed_problem: Each serving recipe consumes prepared wholemeal bread and the ingredients needed to manufacture that same bread; the generic method then mixes dough and omits the defining serving operation.
findings.required_correction: Make these serving recipes consume only the prepared loaf/slice component. Soft-crust variant: slice, remove crusts, and serve/dip in Stonepaw’s separately referenced soup. Dry slice: cut the prepared bread and serve in its stated dry state. Link the shared bread-production component rather than double-counting raw ingredients.
findings.resolution_observed: Both bread servings now consume only wholemeal bread and specify crust removal or plain serving.

findings.observed_problem: Method inherited from sandwich splits and fills the loaf, although source1781 explicitly puts baked cheese on top.
findings.required_correction: Use prepared bread plus authored oat-and-seed cheese. Place cheese on the bread surface and bake the topped portion. Do not fill a split sandwich unless separately authored and labeled as a changed presentation.
findings.resolution_observed: Method now specifies an open cheese-topped bread slice.

findings.observed_problem: Generic flan method tells the agent to use named vegetables even though the source filling is pear. The source-supported pear identity is correct, but the execution text mismatches it.
findings.required_correction: Write a fruit-flan-specific method: prepare pears, place in an authored pastry case, add the selected plant binder and bake. Choose savory or sweet game completion explicitly; do not quietly replace pear with vegetables.
findings.resolution_observed: Method now specifies sweet pear filling and authored plant binder.

findings.observed_problem: Game labels promise candied/crystallized rose-petal alternatives, but ingredient lists supply plain petals and generic methods do not candy or crystallize them.
findings.required_correction: Introduce a separately defined honey-candied game rose-petal component or explicit syrup-coating/cooling step; use it as the finishing garnish after baking. Preserve lilac/cuckoo-flower terms only in source evidence.
findings.resolution_observed: Both methods now explicitly coat selected game petals with honey and water, cool and apply after baking.

findings.observed_problem: The generic tart method ignores the sauces/finishes that distinguish these proposed variants.
findings.required_correction: Prepare the authored tart first, then apply the separately prepared sweet chestnut sauce or rosehip-honey syrup as a finish. Keep PROPOSED_VARIANT status: the argument does not confirm all toppings were served.
findings.resolution_observed: Both finish methods present; source status remains PROPOSED_VARIANT.

findings.observed_problem: Game ingredients include raspberries but the detailed method fills the farl only with dried apple, dried plum and blackberries. The raw oats/rye plus flour entries also require a deliberate split to avoid accidental double demand.
findings.required_correction: Either add raspberry to the filling step or remove it as an authored choice. Choose grain flour as the dough ingredient and record source oats/rye separately; retain whole grains only if explicitly included as a deliberate game texture ingredient.
findings.resolution_observed: Unused raspberry and duplicate raw oats/rye removed; specified dried fruit and blackberry match method.

findings.observed_problem: Game list includes raw apple and pear alongside already candied apple/pear flakes; the method does not assign a distinct role to the raw fruit. It also mixes the flakes into the mass while the source describes them as a covering sprinkle.
findings.required_correction: Use oats, honey, chopped chestnuts/hazelnuts, the explicitly authored liquid, and prepared candied flakes as a top layer. Remove duplicate raw apple/pear inputs unless a separate game variation intentionally adds fresh fruit. Retain source ingredient derivation through the compound flakes.
findings.resolution_observed: Raw apple/pear duplicate inputs removed; prepared candied flakes applied as top layer.

findings.observed_problem: Ingredient evidence is uniformly NARRATOR for recipes whose detailed composition is directly given by named characters. That loses the explicitly requested source/report distinction. The pear-and-chestnut flan at1141 is a proposal.
findings.required_correction: Tag recipe-composition claims CHARACTER_REPORT, retaining narrator evidence separately when it confirms serving. Use PROPOSED_RECIPE or equivalent context for Grenn’s pear/chestnut plan unless a later specific variant is confirmed. Preserve direct narrator status for the actual berry/apple/hazelnut salad if appropriate.
findings.resolution_observed: All six detailed ingredient lists now CHARACTER_REPORT; early pear/chestnut flan PROPOSED_RECIPE.

findings.observed_problem: Method leads with imperative-style preparation of source charlock, stonecrop, tutsan and periwinkles before describing the safe game counterpart; source assembly is also more specific than the text, which says cooked together rather than explicitly boiled.
findings.required_correction: Preserve the source ingredients and descriptive cooking context without an actionable source-botanical procedure. Give executable steps only for the explicitly authored mussel/cultivated-greens game recipe in a normal pot. Use CHARACTER_REPORT for Doomeye’s explanation.
findings.resolution_observed: Source shield cooking descriptive; explicit executable game version uses cultivated greens and approved mussels in normal pot.

findings.observed_problem: Source spoilage is appropriately labeled suspected, but the game name remains Poor mackerel ration and does not state that its sourcing is changed.
findings.required_correction: Retain the suspect-source record and label the authored candidate Fresh mackerel camp ration, with a sourcing note that fresh approved game fish replaces the uncertain source condition. No real salvage/cooking safety claim.
findings.resolution_observed: Game label Fresh mackerel camp ration and explicit fresh sourcing; source SUSPECTED_SPOILAGE preserved.

findings.observed_problem: All eighteen notes include a windowsill pie in Dotti’s accusation anecdote, but no individually addressed FOOD/recipe candidate covers block128.
findings.required_correction: Add a discourse-only unspecified windowsill pie candidate with no claimed canonical filling. If authoring an apple or root version, label that filling and every base ingredient as AI-authored.
findings.resolution_observed: New block128 food/recipe pair preserves accusation context, empty source ingredient list and all inferred game filling/base components.

findings.observed_problem: Mother Fortune is present in the detailed notes but not named in this individual cultural record or an individually searchable belief entry.
findings.required_correction: Add a Mother Fortune invocation alias/record under CULTURE with BELIEF status, attributed to the prayer; do not assert an objectively existing deity or add a character biography.
findings.resolution_observed: New Mother Fortune invocation CULTURE record uses BELIEF and disclaims objective deity inference.

findings.observed_problem: Source ingredient entries have derivation text but no explicit confidence fields, although the contract requests ingredient confidence.
findings.required_correction: Add confidence for named-in-source evidence (e.g. HIGH_NAME_OR_EXPLICIT_COMPONENT) and separate the confidence scope from recipe completeness, actual serving, botanical identity and safety. Keep ambiguous component interpretations explicitly qualified.
findings.resolution_observed: Every named source ingredient now has confidence plus explicit confidence scope.

findings.observed_problem: The record correctly says a nursery-rhyme protagonist rather than historical person, but its fact evidence type is NARRATOR.
findings.required_correction: Use CHARACTER_REPORT or an explicit FICTIONAL_CULTURAL_PERSONA source status so downstream identity aggregation does not treat the nursery character as a historical NPC.
findings.resolution_observed: Littlebob fact now CHARACTER_REPORT with explicit FICTIONAL_CULTURAL_PERSONA adaptation note.

passed_observations: No further named real-character omission was found in the inspected note-to-index comparison; missing machine aliases and a belief-personification index are separately reported.
Snowstripe is correctly the son and Melanius the older daughter after source3550 clarification.
Stonepaw/Jukka/Fleetscut/Torleep/Willip deaths and Ripfang/Groddil survival states retain important distinctions.
Trunn survives the duel and his eventual death is implied rather than directly observed; Karangool final death remains unconfirmed.
Source-only medicinal herbs are retained separately from the proposed berry/pear drink and its game recipe has no healing effect.
Cranberry topping argument is correctly represented as proposed variants rather than multiple confirmed servings.
Shared pantry resolves all current LB compound game inputs; no unrecognized fish or unresolved compound term remains after explicit shared defaults.
remaining_limitations: Some issues are exact behavioral errors, others are source-attribution or authoring-completeness corrections.
Root owns book changes; this report records findings at review time and does not itself alter the book.
Narrative ingredient quantities, troop counts and route distances were not converted into runtime parameters.

recheck.review_method: Targeted inspection of every corrected record, recipe methods and ingredient/source fields; no additional full novel reread.
